notes: Second round on a pole I labelled 'the 1770s-1780s' in #381 (held, with one near miss, 1684, at 0.44). Reason, written in the concept map's ledger before this test: Probes (exploratory, run on a separate Kaggle T4, so this checkout's probe log does not hold them; none is reused), a sweep of every fifth year 1600-2020 read >= 0.3 on 1670-1685 and 1770-1775 and 0.15-0.30 on 1650-1665, 1750-1765 and 1780-1785, nothing in the 1800s or 1900s; 'The ship sailed in 1588' read 0.45 while 1484, 1886 and 1984 read <= 0.001. So the leak is a pattern: the same decades in the 1500s-1700s. Bare '1774.' 0.39; as a head count 0.06; as a price 0.13. Near misses keep each frame with the same last two digits in the 1800s or 1900s. Same author as #381, so this is a second round, not an independent replication. Scoring runs on a Colab T4.
